audit.description: The changed production file git_pw/api.py replaces the requests import with import httpx and meaningfully uses httpx APIs including httpx.Auth, httpx.BasicAuth, httpx.HTTPError, httpx.HTTPStatusError, httpx.Response, httpx.get/post/patch/delete, and httpx.stream. Static and dynamic evidence show no remaining production requests import/use, target imports resolving to site-packages httpx, and no local fake httpx provider.
evidence: git_pw/api.py diff: import requests replaced with import httpx
git_pw/api.py diff: HTTPTokenAuth now subclasses httpx.Auth and implements auth_flow with httpx.Request
git_pw/api.py diff: _get/_post/_patch/_delete use httpx.get, httpx.post, httpx.patch, httpx.delete and catch httpx.HTTPError
git_pw/api.py diff: download path uses httpx.stream and rsp.iter_bytes
requirements.txt diff: requests>=2.0 replaced with httpx>=0.23

No source requests usage is reported in changed production code
